rationale: The only linked fix that touches this file is a feature PR (auto-installing ClientCommand requirements) that renames the commit's DESCRIPTION attribute to description; it does not repair the added lines.

The fix PR (typed and labelled bugfix) says the old mechanism does not properly update all entities via homeassistant.update_entity; the async_update this commit added refreshes the shared UV data object but then calls only self.async_update_state(), and the fix deletes it in favour of coordinators.

The fix changes read_csv's default file filtering and wraps the reader loop in try/except for a clearer error message, which only re-indents the commit's csv.open_csv call; the commit's invalid_row_handler re-init is untouched.

The fix repairs the blame query's unquoted GraphQL arguments and missing ranges lookup, which are older lines of get_blame_for_file; the one line this commit added here (committedDate in the query) is kept unchanged, and the committedDate lookup bug is in integration.py.

The fix swaps the commit's inline subdomain check for the is_using_customer_domain helper and adds new behaviour (inject the customer-domains feature flag when a customer domain is used) to pre-existing feature-flag code, described as a continuation of another PR; nothing in the commit's customerDomain logic is shown to be wrong.
The commit was a pure customer-to-region rename; the fix introduces a new all_silo_model category and merely renames the helper called on the commit's line (filtered_names to to_name_pairs).
The fix is the planned step 4 of the app_id integer-to-string migration and only renames the commit's app_id_str keyword back to app_id.

The commit only renamed local variables here; the fix restructures the function into a retriever class to allow CLI help while the app is not running, moving the renamed lines without correcting them.

The get_blame_for_file method this commit added interpolates name, owner, ref and path into the GraphQL query without quotes and returns the blame object instead of its ranges list; the fix quotes the arguments and reads blame.ranges.
The commit passed mode=brotli.BrotliEncoderMode.TEXT, an attribute name the Python brotli package does not provide; the fix replaces it with brotli.MODE_TEXT.
The linked fix is a follow-up commit of the same pull request that hoists args = None above the if/elif chain instead of setting it in an else branch, which does not change behaviour.

The fix tunes Sentry SDK reporting (capture_message to capture_exception plus replay and project tags, and removal of an older configure_scope call) to get more useful diagnostics; the duplicate-segment check this commit added works the same before and after.
The only linked fix touching this file is the planned step 4 of the app_id integer-to-string migration, which renames the commit's app_id_str keyword back to app_id.

The fix deletes is_saas() and replaces the generic SENTRY_IS_SAAS setting with a dedicated SHOW_SESSION_REPLAY_BANNER setting with the same default; it is a naming/design change and no malfunction of the added function is described.
